## 2. Clean analysis table


```{r clean-data}
prot_df <- data_raw %>%
  transmute(
    gene = `Gene Symbol`,
    ensembl = `Ensembl Gene ID`,
    label = label,

    fc_324_gfp = `f_MSI2_324_WT /EGFP`,
    p_324_gfp  = `p_MSI2_324_WT /EGFP`,

    fc_328_gfp = `f_MSI2_328_WT /EGFP`,
    p_328_gfp  = `p_MSI2_328_WT /EGFP`,

    fc_40aa_gfp = `f_MSI2_328_40AA /EGFP`,
    p_40aa_gfp  = `p_MSI2_328_40AA /EGFP`,

    # original table has 40AA / 328
    fc_40aa_328 = `f_MSI2_328_40AA /MSI2_328_WT`,
    p_40aa_328  = `p_MSI2_328_40AA_MSI2_328_WT`,

    # derived direction: 328 / 40AA
    fc_328_40aa = 1 / `f_MSI2_328_40AA /MSI2_328_WT`,

    # original table has 328 / 324
    fc_328_324 = `f_MSI2_328_WT /MSI2_324_WT`,
    p_328_324  = `p_MSI2_328_WT /MSI2_324_WT`,

    # derived direction: 324 / 328
    fc_324_328 = 1 / `f_MSI2_328_WT /MSI2_324_WT`,

    EGFP_B = EGFP_Rep_B_n_n,
    EGFP_C = EGFP_Rep_C_n_n,

    WT324_A = FLAG_MSI2_324_WT_Rep_A_n_n,
    WT324_B = FLAG_MSI2_324_WT_Rep_B_n_n,
    WT324_C = FLAG_MSI2_324_WT_Rep_C_n_n,

    AA40_A = FLAG_MSI2_328_40AA_WT_Rep_A_n_n,
    AA40_B = FLAG_MSI2_328_40AA_WT_Rep_B_n_n,
    AA40_C = FLAG_MSI2_328_40AA_WT_Rep_C_n_n,

    WT328_A = FLAG_MSI2_328_WT_Rep_A_n_n,
    WT328_B = FLAG_MSI2_328_WT_Rep_B_n_n,
    WT328_C = FLAG_MSI2_328_WT_Rep_C_n_n
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "")

```


## 3. Heatmap/k-means function


```{r heatmap-functions}
make_avg_kmeans_heatmap <- function(df,
                                    comparison = c("328_40AA", "324_328"),
                                    k = 3,
                                    seed = 123, #all eyes on me
                                    genes_to_label = NULL,
                                    title_text = NULL) {

  comparison <- match.arg(comparison)

  if (comparison == "328_40AA") {
    avg_df <- df %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      summarise(
        EGFP = mean(c(EGFP_B, EGFP_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        AA40 = mean(c(AA40_A, AA40_B, AA40_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        WT328 = mean(c(WT328_A, WT328_B, WT328_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    condition_labels <- c("EGFP", "40AA", "328")

    if (is.null(title_text)) {
      title_text <- paste0("Full dataset averaged: EGFP vs 40AA vs 328, k = ", k)
    }
  }

  if (comparison == "324_328") {
    avg_df <- df %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      summarise(
        EGFP = mean(c(EGFP_B, EGFP_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        WT324 = mean(c(WT324_A, WT324_B, WT324_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        WT328 = mean(c(WT328_A, WT328_B, WT328_C), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    condition_labels <- c("EGFP", "324", "328")

    if (is.null(title_text)) {
      title_text <- paste0("Full dataset averaged: EGFP vs 324 vs 328, k = ", k)
    }
  }

  heatmap_mat <- avg_df %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()

  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[rowSums(is.na(heatmap_mat)) < ncol(heatmap_mat), ]

  heatmap_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_mat)))
  heatmap_mat_scaled <- heatmap_mat_scaled[complete.cases(heatmap_mat_scaled), ]

  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(heatmap_mat_scaled, centers = k)

  cluster_df <- tibble(
    gene = rownames(heatmap_mat_scaled),
    cluster = factor(km$cluster)
  )

  ordered_genes <- cluster_df %>%
    arrange(cluster, gene) %>%
    pull(gene)

  mat_ordered <- heatmap_mat_scaled[ordered_genes, ]
  clusters_ordered <- cluster_df$cluster[match(ordered_genes, cluster_df$gene)]

  gaps_row <- which(diff(as.numeric(clusters_ordered)) != 0)

  labels_row <- ifelse(
    rownames(mat_ordered) %in% genes_to_label,
    rownames(mat_ordered),
    ""
  )

  annotation_col <- data.frame(
    Condition = condition_labels
  )
  rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(mat_ordered)

  annotation_row <- data.frame(
    Cluster = clusters_ordered
  )
  rownames(annotation_row) <- rownames(mat_ordered)

  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
    mat_ordered,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_row = gaps_row,
    labels_row = labels_row,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 9,
    scale = "none",
    main = title_text,
    silent = TRUE
  )

  list(
    avg_df = avg_df,
    matrix_scaled = heatmap_mat_scaled,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    plot = heatmap_plot
  )
}
```

```{r}
filter_cluster_hits <- function(df, cluster_genes, fc_col, p_col,
                                fc_cutoff = 2, p_cutoff = 0.5) {
  df %>%
    filter(gene %in% cluster_genes) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[fc_col]]),
      !is.na(.data[[p_col]]),
      .data[[fc_col]] >= fc_cutoff,
      .data[[p_col]] < p_cutoff
    ) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}

genes_328_hits <- filter_cluster_hits(
  prot_df,
  cluster_genes = genes_328_cluster,
  fc_col = "fc_328_gfp",
  p_col = "p_328_gfp",
  fc_cutoff = 2,
  p_cutoff = 0.5
)

genes_324_hits <- filter_cluster_hits(
  prot_df,
  cluster_genes = genes_324_cluster,
  fc_col = "fc_324_gfp",
  p_col = "p_324_gfp",
  fc_cutoff = 2,
  p_cutoff = 0.5
)

filter_cluster_hits2 <- function(df,
                                cluster_genes,
                                fc_col,
                                p_col,
                                fc_cutoff = 2,
                                p_cutoff = 0.5,
                                direction = c("both", "up", "down"),
                                flip_direction = FALSE) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  df %>%
    filter(gene %in% cluster_genes) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      pval = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(fc), !is.na(pval),
      is.finite(fc), is.finite(pval),
      fc > 0, pval > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      log2FC = if (flip_direction) -log2FC else log2FC
    ) %>%
    {
      out <- .
      
      if (direction == "both") {
        out <- out %>%
          filter(abs(log2FC) >= log2(fc_cutoff))
      }
      
      if (direction == "up") {
        out <- out %>%
          filter(log2FC >= log2(fc_cutoff))
      }
      
      if (direction == "down") {
        out <- out %>%
          filter(log2FC <= -log2(fc_cutoff))
      }
      
      out %>%
        filter(pval < p_cutoff)
    } %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}

)

split_cluster_by_fc <- function(df,
                                cluster_genes,
                                fc_col,
                                p_col,
                                fc_cutoff = 2,
                                p_cutoff = 0.5) {
  
  split_df <- df %>%
    filter(gene %in% cluster_genes) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      pval = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(gene), gene != "",
      !is.na(fc), !is.na(pval),
      is.finite(fc), is.finite(pval),
      fc > 0, pval > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      direction = case_when(
        log2FC >= log2(fc_cutoff) & pval < p_cutoff ~ "up_in_324",
        log2FC <= -log2(fc_cutoff) & pval < p_cutoff ~ "up_in_328",
        TRUE ~ "not_specific"
      )
    )
  
  list(
    table = split_df,
    up_in_324 = split_df %>% filter(direction == "up_in_324") %>% pull(gene) %>% unique(),
    up_in_328 = split_df %>% filter(direction == "up_in_328") %>% pull(gene) %>% unique(),
    not_specific = split_df %>% filter(direction == "not_specific") %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
  )
}
```

```{r}
map_symbols_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {
  bitr(
    unique(symbols),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  ) %>%
    distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID)
}

make_ora <- function(hit_genes, universe_genes) {
  universe_map <- map_symbols_to_entrez(universe_genes)
  hit_map <- map_symbols_to_entrez(hit_genes)

  hit_entrez <- unique(hit_map$ENTREZID)
  universe_entrez <- unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)

  list(
    go_bp = enrichGO(
      gene = hit_entrez,
      universe = universe_entrez,
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      ont = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      readable = TRUE
    ),

    go_mf = enrichGO(
      gene = hit_entrez,
      universe = universe_entrez,
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      ont = "MF",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      readable = TRUE
    ),

    reactome = enrichPathway(
      gene = hit_entrez,
      universe = universe_entrez,
      organism = "human",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      readable = TRUE
    ),

    hit_map = hit_map,
    universe_map = universe_map
  )
}

plot_ora_dotplot <- function(enrich_obj, title_text,
                             fdr_cutoff = 0.25,
                             n_terms = 15) {
  df <- as.data.frame(enrich_obj) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    filter(p.adjust < fdr_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(
          title = title_text,
          subtitle = paste0("No terms passed FDR < ", fdr_cutoff)
        )
    )
  }

  dotplot(enrich_obj, showCategory = min(n_terms, nrow(df))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(title_text, " (FDR < ", fdr_cutoff, ")"))
}


plot_ora_dotplot(ora_328_hits$go_bp, "GO BP ORA: 328 cluster + FC/p filter", fdr_cutoff = 0.25)
plot_ora_dotplot(ora_328_hits$go_mf, "GO MF ORA: 328 cluster + FC/p filter", fdr_cutoff = 0.25)
```

```{r}
pull_ora_genes <- function(enrich_obj, fdr_cutoff = 0.25, n_terms = 10) {
  as.data.frame(enrich_obj) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p.adjust), p.adjust < fdr_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
    pull(geneID) %>%
    strsplit("/") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique()
}

genes_324_ora_labels <- c(
  pull_ora_genes(ora_324_specific$go_bp, fdr_cutoff = 0.15, n_terms = 5),
  pull_ora_genes(ora_324_specific$go_mf, fdr_cutoff = 0.15, n_terms = 5),
  pull_ora_genes(ora_324_specific$reactome, fdr_cutoff = 0.15, n_terms = 5)
) %>%
  unique()

genes_328_ora_labels <- c(

  pull_ora_genes(ora_328_specific$reactome, fdr_cutoff = 0.15, n_terms = 5)
) %>%

top_fc_ora_labels <- function(ora_label_genes,
                              df,
                              fc_col,
                              n = 20) {
  df %>%
    filter(gene %in% ora_label_genes) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fc), is.finite(fc), fc > 0) %>%
    mutate(abs_log2FC = abs(log2(fc))) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}
```

```{r}
make_split_volcano <- function(df,
                               cluster_genes,
                               split_table,
                               label_genes = NULL,
                               fc_col,
                               p_col,
                               title_text,
                               fc_cutoff = 2,
                               p_cutoff = 0.5,
                               label_color_324 = "#D9773A",
                               label_color_328 = "#4C78A8",
                               base_color = "grey75") {
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(gene %in% cluster_genes) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      pval = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(fc), !is.na(pval),
      is.finite(fc), is.finite(pval),
      fc > 0, pval > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      negLog10P = -log10(pval)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      split_table %>% dplyr::select(gene, direction),
      by = "gene"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = replace_na(direction, "not_specific"),
      label_this = gene %in% label_genes
    )
  
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(label_this)
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P)) +
    
    # base points (all grey)
    geom_point(color = base_color, size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    
    # highlighted labeled genes colored by direction
    geom_point(
      data = label_df,
      aes(color = direction),
      size = 4,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = gene),
      color = "black",
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-log2(fc_cutoff), log2(fc_cutoff)),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "up_in_324" = label_color_324,
        "up_in_328" = label_color_328,
        "not_specific" = "black"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "up_in_324" = "324-specific",
        "up_in_328" = "328-specific",
        "not_specific" = "Other"
      )
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cluster genes shown; only labeled genes highlighted"
      ),
      x = "log2 FC: 324 vs 328",
      y = expression(-log[10](p)),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## 6. Volcano function for cluster genes

#This colors cluster-of-interest genes blue wherever they fall.


```{r cluster-volcano-function}

make_filtered_cluster_volcano <- function(df,
                                          cluster_genes,
                                          hit_genes,
                                          label_genes,
                                          fc_col,
                                          p_col,
                                          title_text,
                                          fc_cutoff = 2,
                                          p_cutoff = 0.5,
                                          hit_color = "#D9773A",
                                          other_color = "grey75") {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(gene %in% cluster_genes) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      pval = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fc), !is.na(pval), is.finite(fc), is.finite(pval), fc > 0, pval > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      negLog10P = -log10(pval),
      category = ifelse(gene %in% hit_genes, "Pass FC/p filter", "Cluster only"),
      label_this = gene %in% label_genes
    )

  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(label_this)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P, color = category)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log2(fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = gene),
      color = "black",
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Pass FC/p filter" = hit_color,
        "Cluster only" = other_color
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0("Cluster genes only; colored if FC ≥ ", fc_cutoff, " and p < ", p_cutoff),
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = expression(-log[10](p)),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r cluster-scatter-function}
make_cluster_scatter <- function(df,
                                 y_fc_col,
                                 x_fc_col,
                                 genes_to_label,
                                 title_text,
                                 flip_x = FALSE,
                                 highlight_color = "#0072B2",
                                 base_color = "grey80",
                                 x_label = "log2 fold change",
                                 y_label = "log2 fold change") {
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      x_fc = .data[[x_fc_col]],
      y_fc = .data[[y_fc_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(x_fc), !is.na(y_fc),
      is.finite(x_fc), is.finite(y_fc),
      x_fc > 0, y_fc > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      x_log2FC = log2(x_fc),
      x_log2FC = if (flip_x) -x_log2FC else x_log2FC,
      y_log2FC = log2(y_fc),
      highlight = gene %in% genes_to_label
    )
  
  highlight_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(highlight)
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x_log2FC, y = y_log2FC)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
    geom_point(color = base_color, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(
      data = highlight_df,
      color = highlight_color,
      size = 3.8,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = highlight_df,
      aes(label = gene),
      color = "black",
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey50"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "Highlighted genes selected from k-means cluster",
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## 8. GO/Reactome overlap analysis for cluster genes

#This is **ORA/overlap**, not GSEA. Universe = all mapped proteins in your proteomics table.


```{r ora-functions}
map_symbols_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {
  bitr(
    unique(symbols),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  ) %>%
    distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID)
}

make_cluster_ora <- function(cluster_genes, universe_genes) {

  universe_map <- map_symbols_to_entrez(universe_genes)
  cluster_map <- map_symbols_to_entrez(cluster_genes)

  cluster_entrez <- unique(cluster_map$ENTREZID)
  universe_entrez <- unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)

  go_bp <- enrichGO(
    gene = cluster_entrez,
    universe = universe_entrez,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    readable = TRUE
  )

  go_mf <- enrichGO(
    gene = cluster_entrez,
    universe = universe_entrez,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "MF",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    readable = TRUE
  )

  reactome <- enrichPathway(
    gene = cluster_entrez,
    universe = universe_entrez,
    organism = "human",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    readable = TRUE
  )

  list(
    go_bp = go_bp,
    go_mf = go_mf,
    reactome = reactome,
    cluster_map = cluster_map,
    universe_map = universe_map
  )
}

plot_ora_dotplot <- function(enrich_obj,
                             title_text,
                             fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
                             n_terms = 15) {
  
  df <- as.data.frame(enrich_obj) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    filter(p.adjust < fdr_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(
          title = title_text,
          subtitle = paste0("No terms passed FDR < ", fdr_cutoff)
        ) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        )
    )
  }
  
  dotplot(
    enrich_obj,
    showCategory = min(n_terms, nrow(df))
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste0(title_text, " (FDR < ", fdr_cutoff, ")")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#so those ORAs are defined by clusters. I'm also curious if we do FC cutoffs how that looks. 

make_cutoff_gene_set <- function(df,
                                 fc_col,
                                 p_col,
                                 fc_cutoff = 2,
                                 p_cutoff = 0.05,
                                 direction = c("up", "down"),
                                 flip_direction = FALSE) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  out <- df %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      pval = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(gene), gene != "",
      !is.na(fc), !is.na(pval),
      is.finite(fc), is.finite(pval),
      fc > 0, pval > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      log2FC = if (flip_direction) -log2FC else log2FC
    )
  
  if (direction == "up") {
    out <- out %>%
      filter(log2FC >= log2(fc_cutoff), pval < p_cutoff)
  }
  
  if (direction == "down") {
    out <- out %>%
      filter(log2FC <= -log2(fc_cutoff), pval < p_cutoff)
  }
  
  out %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}
```

```{r GSEA functions}
make_ranked_gene_list <- function(df,
                                  fc_col,
                                  gene_subset = NULL,
                                  flip_direction = FALSE) {
  
  rank_df <- df %>%
    filter(if (is.null(gene_subset)) TRUE else gene %in% gene_subset) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      fc = .data[[fc_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(gene), gene != "",
      !is.na(fc), is.finite(fc), fc > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = log2(fc),
      log2FC = if (flip_direction) -log2FC else log2FC
    ) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  gene_list <- rank_df$log2FC
  names(gene_list) <- rank_df$gene
  
  sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
}

convert_ranked_list_to_entrez <- function(gene_list_symbol) {
  
  id_map <- bitr(
    names(gene_list_symbol),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
  
  rank_df <- tibble(
    SYMBOL = names(gene_list_symbol),
    score = as.numeric(gene_list_symbol)
  ) %>%
    inner_join(id_map, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
    group_by(ENTREZID) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  gene_list_entrez <- rank_df$score
  names(gene_list_entrez) <- rank_df$ENTREZID
  
  sort(gene_list_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)
}

run_gsea_flex <- function(df,
                          fc_col,
                          gene_subset = NULL,
                          flip_direction = FALSE,
                          analysis = c("GO_BP", "GO_MF", "Reactome"),
                          minGSSize = 10,
                          maxGSSize = 500,
                          pvalueCutoff = 1) {
  
  analysis <- match.arg(analysis)
  
  gene_list_symbol <- make_ranked_gene_list(
    df = df,
    fc_col = fc_col,
    gene_subset = gene_subset,
    flip_direction = flip_direction
  )
  
  gene_list_entrez <- convert_ranked_list_to_entrez(gene_list_symbol)
  
  if (analysis == "GO_BP") {
    return(
      gseGO(
        geneList = gene_list_entrez,
        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
        keyType = "ENTREZID",
        ont = "BP",
        minGSSize = minGSSize,
        maxGSSize = maxGSSize,
        pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (analysis == "GO_MF") {
    return(
      gseGO(
        geneList = gene_list_entrez,
        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
        keyType = "ENTREZID",
        ont = "MF",
        minGSSize = minGSSize,
        maxGSSize = maxGSSize,
        pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (analysis == "Reactome") {
    return(
      ReactomePA::gsePathway(
        geneList = gene_list_entrez,
        organism = "human",
        minGSSize = minGSSize,
        maxGSSize = maxGSSize,
        pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

plot_gsea_nes <- function(gsea_obj,
                          title_text,
                          fdr_cutoff = 0.25,
                          n_terms = 20) {
  
  plot_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_obj) %>%
    filter(!is.na(NES), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    filter(p.adjust < fdr_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_terms)
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(
          title = title_text,
          subtitle = paste0("No pathways passed FDR < ", fdr_cutoff)
        ) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        )
    )
  }
  
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Positive NES", "Negative NES"),
      Description = forcats::fct_reorder(Description, NES)
    )
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = NES, y = Description, size = -log10(p.adjust), color = Direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
      y = NULL,
      size = "-log10(FDR)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

run_reactome_gsea_safe <- function(df,
                                   fc_col,
                                   gene_subset = NULL,
                                   flip_direction = FALSE,
                                   minGSSize = 10,
                                   maxGSSize = 500,
                                   pvalueCutoff = 1,
                                   seed = 123) {
  
  gene_list_symbol <- make_ranked_gene_list(
    df = df,
    fc_col = fc_col,
    gene_subset = gene_subset,
    flip_direction = flip_direction
  )
  
  gene_list_entrez <- convert_ranked_list_to_entrez(gene_list_symbol)
  
  # remove zero scores because they can create problems in ReactomePA/fgsea
  gene_list_entrez <- gene_list_entrez[gene_list_entrez != 0]
  
  # add tiny jitter if there are ties
  if (any(duplicated(gene_list_entrez))) {
    set.seed(seed)
    gene_list_entrez <- gene_list_entrez + rnorm(length(gene_list_entrez), 0, 1e-10)
    gene_list_entrez <- sort(gene_list_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)
  }
  
  ReactomePA::gsePathway(
    geneList = gene_list_entrez,
    organism = "human",
    minGSSize = minGSSize,
    maxGSSize = maxGSSize,
    pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}
```
